messages:
Anna Li: quick heads-up — ran the nightly microprobe across routes and hit a consistent TTFT bump on /api/chat (p95 +120ms). decode time unchanged, looks like we’re spending extra time in kernel selection step for batches with short prefixes :eyes:
Raj Patel: interesting, can you paste the microprobe output? was this with softbatch enabled?
Anna Li: pasted below — softbatch=on, batcher=adaptive. note the kernel_choice toggles right before token generation for these requests:
```
route=/api/chat  seq=1 prefix_tokens=6 kernel_choice=kernel_v2 -> kernel_v3 at t=37.2ms
batch_id=8421  kv_cache_hits=0 kv_prefetch=miss
ttft=156.7ms decode=29.4ms kernel_selection=95.1ms
```
Miguel Santos: kv_prefetch miss + kernel flip is suspicious. if prefetch fails we fall back to non-prefetch kernel which has longer init path (we saw that in the A/B runs). are these short-conversation prefixes?
Anna Li: yes, short prompts (<=8 tokens). also noticed this only on hostpool-7. perfbot ran a comparison across hosts earlier tonight.
PerfBot: automated-note: nightly-probe summary attached: hostpool-7 p95 ttft increase 28% vs baseline; correlated with kernel_v3 ramp on short prefixes; kv_hit_rate on hostpool-7 dropped from 87% -> 41% at 02:10 UTC.
Sam K: could be KV eviction policy on that pool. Did anything change in allocator yesterday?
Jia Chen: I pushed a tiny change to slab allocator tuning on hostpool-7 at 01:55 for memory compaction. it may have changed eviction behavior. reverting would be quick to test.
Raj Patel: we should add a token-level waterfall on the dashboards showing: prequeue, kernel_select, kernel_init, kvcache_prefetch, decode. currently we only show aggregate queue+decode.
Anna Li: agreed — proposal: a lightweight probe label that tags kernel_choice and kv_hit per token, and export timing buckets. quick PR to instrument: add counters and histogram: token.kernel_select_ms, token.kv_prefetch_ms, token.kernel_init_ms, token.decode_ms.
Miguel Santos: add hostpool tag and route tag. also include batch_size and prefix_length as labels for aggregation.
Sam K: for short-term mitigation, Jia — can you roll back compaction on hostpool-7 and run the probe again?
Jia Chen: rolling back now, will re-run probe in ~5m and post results.
PerfBot: perf-check queued: probe-run id=pr-2509012345-1, expected complete ~2509012465. will post delta metrics when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Anna Li: thanks — if rollback fixes it we need an RCA: eviction -> kvcache miss -> kernel fallback -> TTFT spike. then dashboard + alert on kernel_choice-flip rate per hostpool.
Raj Patel: also add sampling flamegraph for kernel_init path when kernel_choice != chosen_by_policy (we want to see overheads).
Miguel Santos: noted. I'll draft dashboard panels and a short alert doc. everyone add any missing metrics to the PR checklist.
Jia Chen: probe done: hostpool-7 p95 ttft back to baseline. kv_hit_rate restored to 85%. posting logs next. :thumbsup:
